table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= item.name,  
			accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
			address = dbo.customer.address1,
			salesman = dbo.users.username, 
			headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
			custrefno = dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
			saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode,
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
         dbo.saleledger.custcode, 
         gcode = max(saledetail.gcode),   
         icode = max(saledetail.icode),
         batch = max(saledetail.batch), 
         expiry = max(saledetail.expiry),   
			looseqty =sum(saledetail.looseqty),
			packqty  = max(saledetail.packqty),
			packunits=max(saledetail.packunits),
	 		saleprice=max(saledetail.saleprice),
	 		discperc = max(saledetail.discperc),
			packprice= max(saledetail.packprice),
         salestax = max(saledetail.salestax),
			rno = 1,
			rowid1=max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)   

    FROM saleledger, 
			saledetail, 
			accounts, 
			customer,
			users, 
			item  
 
   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode >= :ar_SInvCode ) AND
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode <= :ar_EInvCode ) AND
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode In (:ar_custcode)) AND
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode) AND 
			( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)

GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode ,
         dbo.saleledger.salecatcode,
         dbo.saleledger.custcode,
         dbo.accounts.name, 
			dbo.customer.address1,
	 		dbo.users.username, 
	 		dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	 		dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	 		dbo.saleledger.date,   
	 		dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
         dbo.saledetail.icode,
         dbo.item.name

ORDER BY   rowid1 /*dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL*/

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)
